raw_response: BNY Mellon described strong growth in its ETF servicing business, noting that ETF assets under client care (AUCA) reached $2.8 trillion by the end of 2024, representing an increase of over 60% year-over-year. The company stated that inflows into ETFs on its platform outpaced the market and highlighted particular strength in this area as validation of multiyear investments made into these platforms.
